  "verdict_definition": "Good enough means the live Project Model v1 is the primary artifact, fully derived from this run's ProjectGraph/source/config (no cached prior model), passes the deterministic gate, and accurately captures fmc-mcp's read-only FMC MCP server architecture: client component correctly ranked and richly profiled, runtime contracts/external surfaces/invariants/quality gates/backlog/open questions populated with source-derived (non-tautological) content, and all provenance refs resolving. It is judged purely on model/snapshot/gate/artifact quality, NOT on any candidate selection, proposal, scorecard, or closed-loop outcome.",
  "must_have": [
    "Project Model v1 emitted as the primary artifact for this run with iterationReadiness populated",
    "component.fmc-mcp-client present and ranked ahead of the tiny entrypoint/server module",
    "client component explicitly references auth/session lifecycle, rate limiting, retry/pagination, and endpoint wrappers",
    "responsibility summaries each include >=2 source-derived symbols or behavioral tags; no tautological file-bucket summaries",
    "runtime contracts cover: server constructs/owns FMCClient during lifespan; injects via resources.set_client; tools depend on injected resource client; server registers MCP resources; registers MCP tools; delegates handlers to tools.py; stdio and HTTP/SSE modes surfaced",
    "external surfaces include fmc://system/info, fmc://devices/list, fmc://objects/network, fmc://deployment/status; IP object search and deployment status tools; console script mcp-server-fmc; settings/env names; FMC REST endpoint families; FastMCP and httpx deps",
    "product invariants model read-only external ops, distinguish auth-token POSTs from domain reads, SecretStr/settings redaction, 120 req/min and 10 concurrent limits, live/credentialed test boundary, public MCP resource/tool contract",
    "quality gates expose pytest/ruff/mypy where configured; acceptance lists only safe local commands",
    "every record derived from ProjectGraph/source/config with resolving provenance refs; no cached prior model used as source truth",
    "deterministic gate passes and gate result is reproducible for the same commit"
  ],
  "should_have": [
    "priority backlog with items like verify read-only behavior, verify server/resources/tools wiring, run/expose lint+type checks, document/refactor client sub-responsibilities",
    "open questions covering live-test credential gating, whether client.py should split, and whether default acceptance is pytest+ruff+mypy vs advisory lint/type",
    "enriched component profiles and import-contract closure across modules",
    "provider metadata recorded on the model/run",
    "uncertain or low-confidence signals routed to gaps/open questions rather than asserted as facts",
    "source-span provenance used for inferred contracts where no symbol-level ref exists",
    "deterministic graph/provenance such that re-running on 25f44580 yields an equivalent model"
  ],
  "red_flags": [
    "tiny entrypoint/server ranked at or above fmc-mcp-client, or client component missing/under-profiled",
    "tautological file-bucket responsibility summaries or summaries lacking source-derived symbols/tags",
    "missing rate-limit (120/min, 10 concurrent), SecretStr redaction, or read-only-vs-auth-POST invariants",
    "external surfaces missing resource URIs, tools, console script, or FastMCP/httpx dependencies",
    "acceptance/quality gates including unsafe, networked, or credentialed commands",
    "provenance refs that do not resolve, or records not traceable to graph/source/config",
    "evidence of reuse of a cached prior model as source truth",
    "non-deterministic gate or model output across identical runs",
    "fabricated/hallucinated endpoints, settings, or contracts not present in source",
    "scope creep into intake/scorecard/proposal selection or candidate promotion"
  ],
  "not_required_for_this_step": [
    "intake, scorecard, or proposal generation",
    "selecting, ranking, or promoting any candidate/proposal",
    "proposal registry/lifecycle, branch management, or stale-branch cleanup",
    "live closed-loop proof or downstream verification of applied changes",
    "running fmc-mcp's actual live/credentialed tests against a real FMC",
    "resolving the docs-only effective-path gap (downstream concern)"
  ],
  "review_checklist": [
    "Confirm Project Model v1 is the primary artifact and iterationReadiness is populated",
    "Verify fmc-mcp-client ranks ahead of entrypoint and names auth/session, rate limiting, retry/pagination, endpoint wrappers",
    "Check each responsibility summary for >=2 source-derived symbols/tags and reject file-bucket tautologies",
    "Validate all eight runtime contract statements (lifespan client ownership, set_client injection, tool dependency, resource+tool registration, tools.py delegation, stdio+HTTP/SSE)",
    "Cross-check external surfaces list against the four fmc:// URIs, two tools, console script, settings, REST families, FastMCP/httpx",
    "Validate invariants for read-only modeling, auth-POST vs read distinction, redaction, rate limits, test boundary, public contract",
    "Confirm quality gates expose pytest/ruff/mypy and acceptance contains only safe local commands",
    "Sample provenance refs and confirm they resolve to graph/source/config; confirm source-span provenance acceptable for inferred contracts",
    "Confirm uncertain signals appear as gaps/open questions, not asserted facts",
    "Confirm no cached prior model is used as source truth and the deterministic gate passes",
    "Spot-check backlog and open questions against expected examples",
    "Confirm no scope creep into proposals/selection/closed-loop"
  ],
  "summary": "A good live Project Model v1 decomposition for fmc-mcp is a deterministic, fully source-derived primary artifact that passes the gate and accurately captures the read-only FMC MCP server: client component correctly ranked and richly profiled (auth/session, rate limiting, retry/pagination, endpoint wrappers), non-tautological responsibility summaries, complete runtime contracts, external surfaces, invariants, quality gates, backlog, and open questions, with all provenance resolving and no cached prior model. It must be judged on model/snapshot/gate/artifact quality only — not on candidate selection, proposals, or closed-loop outcomes, which are out of scope for this step."
